question: why is main green at 620 below-B definitions against a recorded baseline of 599?
measured: pmat 3.41.1 comply check --checks CB-200 --format json, cold XDG_CACHE_HOME, git archive of merge-base 00058476c323: '620 definition(s) below minimum grade B -- 21 OVER the recorded baseline of 599' (Fail); also 620 on main c68deb494
cause: nothing on main measures the count. scripts/check_cb200_tdg_grade.sh does not exist on origin/main (the car introduces it; guard_tree.sh picks up scripts/check_*.sh). check_complexity_ratchet.sh on main only ratchets the NUMBER in scripts/cb200_baseline.txt and checks it equals .pmat-gates.toml [tdg] baseline -- a shrink-only number that is never compared with the tree. The only pmat comply call in main's workflows is book.yml's, advisory (|| echo ::warning::) and unfiltered. So 21 below-B definitions merged one at a time with every required check green.
consequence: a gate that does not see main is theater: the recorded 599 described no tree after 237fbc32f (measured 602 there).
remedy: car #4429 wires check_cb200_tdg_grade.sh into guard_tree (every PR, cold index) and re-baselines once to 617 via receipt scripts/cb200_baseline.rebaseline (measured 620 at the merge-base); the 19 over 598 are cb200-main-below-b-0701.jsonl. Open for 0.70.1: run the guard on main pushes / nightly too, so main's own drift is measured, not only PRs'.

title: CB-200 is green on main at 620 against the 599 baseline: the ratchet step is scoped away from the count, it never measures it
evidence: pmat 3.41.1 `comply check --checks CB-200` on main cbf623e5b: "620 definition(s) below minimum grade B — 21 OVER the recorded baseline of 599", rc=1 (183s warm index, ~24 min cold). The required step (ci.yml:1801-1802, scripts/check_complexity_ratchet.sh) runs and is NOT skipped and NOT reading a stale baseline (599 in both .pmat-gates.toml and scripts/cb200_baseline.txt), but its CB-200 legs are cb200_pair_check (toml == mirror file) and baseline_ratchet_check (mirror file shrink-only vs origin/main): typed numbers compared with typed numbers. Mechanism proof: with a PATH shim pmat that logs argv and answers `comply` with 9999 below-grade, the guard on cbf623e5b exits 0 (PASS D2); argv log = 54× `analyze complexity`, 3× `--version`, 0× `comply`. No required job runs pmat comply: only .githooks (pre-push `|| true`) and book.yml:191, which is advisory and reads tail status through a pipe (`pmat comply check 2>&1 | tail -10 || echo ::warning::`), so even its warning cannot fire. The .pmat-gates.toml comment already records one breach (#3004, 603) merged for this reason.
repro: cd <main checkout>; pmat comply check --checks CB-200  # 620, rc 1. Then: PATH=<shim dir>:$PATH bash scripts/check_complexity_ratchet.sh  # rc 0, shim log shows no comply call
fix: branch fix/cb200-measured-count (cop ruling 2026-09-26): NO per-PR measured leg. check_complexity_ratchet.sh --cb200-measured is NIGHTLY ONLY and RED when pmat comply CB-200 exceeds scripts/cb200_measured_ceiling.txt = 620 (measured at cbf623e5b); the ceiling is shrink-only against origin/main on every PR (typed, cheap). Selftest 10/10. Nightly wiring is a .github diff (3/3 agy). Burn-down of the 21: FND-20260926-cb200-burn-down-21 (0.70.1). Secondary: book.yml:191 pipe-status.

title: 0.70.1: burn CB-200 down from the measured 620 to the [tdg] baseline 599 (21 definitions below grade B)
evidence: pmat 3.41.1 comply check --checks CB-200 on main cbf623e5b: 620 definition(s) below minimum grade B, 21 OVER the recorded baseline of 599. They merged because no required job measured the count (FND-20260926-cb200-main-green-over-baseline).
repro: pmat comply check --checks CB-200  # on main; lists the definitions below B
fix: refactor or revert the 21 definitions; lower scripts/cb200_measured_ceiling.txt with each step until it meets [tdg] baseline 599. Raising either number is not the fix.
